description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a debit/credit card payment page, including UI components, input handling, and navigation logic.

classes.name: CreditCardPage
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the payment page for entering credit/debit card details, displaying a stylized card UI, and handling navigation upon submission.

methods.name: bodyData
methods.description: Builds the main scrollable content of the page, including header, card display, and input fields.

methods.name: creditCardWidget
methods.description: Creates a visual representation of the credit card with background and overlay elements.

methods.name: cardEntries
methods.description: Constructs the widget displaying the current card number, expiry, and CVV, updating dynamically via streams.

methods.name: fillEntries
methods.description: Provides input fields for card number, expiry date, CVV, and cardholder name.

methods.name: floatingBar
methods.description: Returns a floating action button labeled 'Continue' that navigates to the payment success page when pressed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire scaffold, wiring together all components and UI logic.
